title: Run one Codex request
responsibility: Runs one ephemeral Codex turn with the requested model, forwards public results and closes the connection afterward.

inputs.name: codexTurn.command
inputs.description: The executable and arguments for the Codex app-server connection.

inputs.name: codexTurn.turn
inputs.description: The requested model, effort, working directory, prompt, access mode, signal and callbacks, plus an optional local reference image. Write access requests danger-full-access; read-only access requests the read-only sandbox. The thread uses OpenAI, never asks for approval, enables image generation and is ephemeral.

outputs.name: codexTurn
outputs.description: A promise for completed public message text joined with newlines, the selected model and image-generation result items. Public text, image status and reported file changes are forwarded to callbacks. The connection is disposed after success or failure.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects a different model or provider, startup/request failures, a non-retrying server error, an unsuccessful terminal status or a turn taking more than fifteen minutes.

errors.name: RunCancelled
errors.description: Rejects when already cancelled or when cancellation is observed during the turn. Attempts to interrupt an active turn before closing its connection.
